label: Teltonika OTD144
description: Outdoor Wi-Fi 4G Cat 4 router: 2x 100 Mbps Ethernet, PoE in on one and PoE out on the other.
notes: Vendor figures: **two 10/100 Mbps Ethernet ports**, one **PoE in** and one **PoE out**, LTE Cat 4, integrated Wi-Fi, **IP55**. The difference from the OTD140 is the Wi-Fi radio on the same two-port chassis - and **the ports are still fast Ethernet**, so the wireless is served by a 100 Mbps uplink.
